items.title: American Cancer Society Recommends Guardant Health’s Shield Blood Test in Updated Colorectal Cancer Screening Guidelines
items.summary: Updated ACS guideline offers Shield as a new choice for over 50 million eligible Americans who are not up to date with their colorectal cancer screening Shield is the first and only FDA-approved blood test included in both ACS and NCCN guidelines Guardant Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: GH), a leading precision oncology company, announced that its FDA-approved Shield(tm) blood test is now included in updated American Cancer Society (ACS) Colorectal Cancer (CRC) Screening Guidelines published today. The major screening guideline update recommends Shield as a choice for patients who decline or have not completed stool-based or visual examination screening tests. In an effort to address persistent screening gaps and rising CRC rates in adults under 65, ACS guidelines now recommend Shield blood-based CRC screening as a new option to expand access and screening participation. Shield is the first and only FDA-approved blood test for primary colorectal cancer screening in average-risk adults age 45

items.title: The Best Bags to Carry Everything She Needs for After-School Activities
items.summary: We know school life can be chaotic. And honestly, that's where the magic lives. It's sneakers and ballet slippers on the same day. It's math homework wedged between rehearsals. It's snacks in the car, quick changes in the backseat, and a schedule that might change every day. The right bag doesn't try to simplify her life into one lane. It moves with her, holding it all together without getting in the way, without asking her to choose between style and function. Because she's not choosing, she's doing it all! For Those Days That Don't Pack Light There's a moment (usually in the middle of an already busy week) when the list of what she needs feels… ambitious. Extra shoes. A change of clothes. Water bottle. Warm-up gear. Maybe a costume piece or two. This is where lightweight yet roomy duffel bags quietly become essential. The Large Original Duffel is built for exactly those moments: • A roomy interior that doesn't make you play favorites with what comes along. • Three interior slip pockets that keep smaller essentials from disappearing into the void. • Exterior side and front pockets for the things you need right now (phone, lip balm, hair ties). • Soft, durable quilted cotton that holds up to daily use, yet still feels like something you actually want to carry. It's the kind of bag that easily transitions from gym to studio to wherever she's headed next. Which is why it's a natural fit for dance bags for girls and just as perfect for sports practices that require a little (or a lot) of everything. "This duffel is sturdy, spacious, and so cute!" ~ Emma Big Days Call For Big Bag Energy Some days aren't local. Some days start early, end late, and involve a lot of moving parts, including travel, quick transitions, and long stretches in between. This is where dance duffle bags for girls step into their next chapter. The Adair Rolling Duffel is designed for those bigger moments: • Smooth-rolling wheels and a telescoping handle make navigating busy spaces easier. • A structured design that stands upright (because balance matters, even off the stage). • Plenty of storage spaces with zip pockets inside and out to keep everything in its place. • Lightweight durability that holds up through travel days, competitions, and repeat performances. It's the bag that takes some of the weight off, literally and mentally, so she can focus on what she came to do. Pro tip: Convenient storage pouches are her best friend when it comes to bigger bags, whether for after school or tournament travel. Keep hair accessories, makeup and more organized and easy to reach. What To Pack In Your Cheer Bag For Practice Or Competition If you've ever left one thing behind, you know, it's never just one thing. Our Large Original Duffel and Adair Rolling Duffel bags help make it easier to keep the essentials together: • Practice outfit, plus an extra top • Cheer shoes and socks • Hair ties, bows, and a brush • Water bottle • A small towel • Deodorant or body spray • Snacks for a quick energy boost • Mini first aid kit For Creative Minds Who Carry More Than Just Books Not every after-school plan involves a uniform or a practice field. Some days are about ideas, sketching, writing, building, learning, and experimenting. The Bancroft Backpack understands that kind of rhythm: • A dedicated laptop compartment (fits up to 15") for digital work and creative tools. • Multiple compartments and interior organization for notebooks, art supplies, and everything in between. • A front pocket with built-in slips (because pens, pencils, and markers have a way of disappearing when you need them most). • Side pockets that are designed to actually fit water bottles and keep them snug. • Adjustable straps that make it comfortable from their first class of the day to their final after-school activity. It's structured but not rigid, functional but still expressive. Exactly what creative days call for. "I love this bag! I use this all the time! Super light easy to clean." ~ Samantha Less In Your Hands. More On Your Mind. Some parts of the day call for the essentials, not the entire locker. Walking into practice, grabbing a snack, meeting friends, and keeping valuables close during a competition are some of the times when this bag earns its place as the go-to choice. The Original Zip Hipster keeps things simple, smart, and stylish: • Three zippered compartments to keep phone, keys, and wallet from becoming one big mystery pile. • A lightweight design that's easy to carry from one activity to the next. • An adjustable strap, so she can wear it her way, hands-free. It's the bag for the in-between moments that still deserve a little style. Keep what you need within easy reach while everything else stays in the big bag. “It's a very handy bag! It holds all I need and is not overloaded.” ~ Judith Snacks & Hydration Matter, Too A long day needs more than a good attitude. Between class, practice, rehearsal, games, and the ride home, snacks and drinks should be part of the plan, not an afterthought. For everyday snacks, lunches, and quick fuel, the Lunch Bag keeps things compact and easy: • Compact, easy to carry, and designed with a food-safe, insulated lining. • Keeps meals and snacks fresh through long afternoons. • Simple, practical, and surprisingly essential. For longer days, outdoor activities, tournaments, or group snacks, the Cooler Backpack offers more room to work with: • Hands-free and built for movement, with insulated storage that keeps drinks and snacks cool. • Spacious enough for longer days, when one snack isn't going to cut it. • Durable and easy to bring along, wherever the day leads. We'll keep you prepared because hunger always has terrible timing. Her Day. Her Bag. Her Rules. There's no single version of after-school life. Some days run on schedules, uniforms, and practice times. Others are all improv, quick changes, and “Wait, where are my shoes?” That's the beauty of it. The right bag doesn't tell her how to show up. It simply keeps up with her gear, plans, style, and every version of herself she brings to the day. Find the Vera Bradley bag that fits her next big thing and everything she needs to bring with it.
